summary: Iteration 7: SMTP-bounded fix + AdminAccessLinkRequest.level validation verified. Both SMTP-unreachable code paths now finish in ~10-11s wall-clock (well under 15s target and under the <13s stretch goal). Level Pydantic validator rejects 'invalid' with 422, accepts 'demo'/'full', and normalizes 'DEMO' -> 'demo'. Regression: sectors=3, admin login, /api/reviews (fresh captcha) all pass. All 5 items in the review request are satisfied.

code_review.helper: _send_email_bounded at server.py:26 correctly wraps asyncio.to_thread with asyncio.wait_for(timeout=12). Catches asyncio.TimeoutError and generic Exception, returns False so callers can persist email_status='failed'.
code_review.smtp_ssl_timeout_5s: server.py:361 and :453 both use smtplib.SMTP_SSL(..., timeout=5). Combined with the 12s asyncio hard cap this yields observed 10-11s wall-clock (single TCP connect ~5s + SSL wrap ~5s, well under the cap).
code_review.level_validator: server.py:1302 field_validator normalizes to lowercase and rejects anything outside {'demo','full'} -> Pydantic 422. Correct.
code_review.belt_and_braces: Good separation: smtplib per-socket timeout limits worst-case failure of each syscall; asyncio.wait_for provides hard wall-clock ceiling regardless of future smtplib internals. Recommended by previous iteration and now implemented.

pre_existing_unrelated.issue: Test expected old behavior (unknown level silently normalized). Now correctly rejected with 422 per new validator. Test is out-of-date, NOT a code bug. Recommend deleting/updating that pre-existing test.
Pre-existing: customer_email stored/returned lowercased ('test_skip@example.com' vs 'TEST_skip@example.com'). Unchanged by this iteration.

Pre-existing iteration-6 test checks top-level 'email_sent'/'id' but response shape is {success, link:{id,email_status}}. Assertion out-of-date; iteration-7 test in test_iteration7_smtp_and_validation.py uses correct shape.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Update or remove 3 pre-existing tests whose assertions became stale after the level validator + response-shape stabilization: (a) test_create_unknown_level_normalizes -> should now expect 422, (b) test_validate_token_works -> compare lowercased emails, (c) test_smtp_async_timing.py::test_access_link_creation_with_send_email -> check body['link']['email_status'] instead of top-level 'email_sent'.
(Nice-to-have) server.py is still ~2027 lines; splitting into modules would improve maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: SMTP fix is now spec-compliant: 10-11s wall-clock << 15s cap, event loop is not blocked (verified in iteration 6), no coroutine bugs.
AdminAccessLinkRequest.level validator is defensive: case-insensitive + whitespace-strip + explicit allow-list. Good.
Pre-existing stale tests in tests/test_admin_access_links.py should be updated to reflect the new (correct) validator behavior.

success_rate.backend_iter7_scope: 9/9 PASS (100%). Wall-clock: budget=10.21s, access-links=11.27s (both under 13s stretch goal).
success_rate.backend_full_regression: backend/tests 29/29 PASS + tests/ 55 pass + 1 skip + 3 stale-assertion failures (all pre-existing, unrelated).

Three pre-existing tests in /app/tests/test_admin_access_links.py + /app/tests/test_smtp_async_timing.py have stale assertions and should be updated, not treated as bugs.
rca of the issue: N/A - no new bugs found. Combination of smtplib.SMTP_SSL(timeout=5) + asyncio.wait_for(timeout=12) around asyncio.to_thread produces bounded wall-clock ~10-11s in the SMTP-unreachable path, comfortably under the 15s target and under the 13s stretch goal.
